query:
SELECT `node`.`ref`, `node`.`resource_type_field`, `node`.`name`, `node`.`parent`, `node`.`order_by`, `node`.`active`, 
        CASE
        WHEN
            POSITION(? IN node.name) > 0
        THEN
            TRIM(SUBSTRING(name,
                    POSITION(? IN node.name) + ?,
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                            POSITION('~' IN SUBSTRING(node.name,
                                    POSITION(? IN node.name) + ?,
                                    LENGTH(node.name) - 1)) > 0
                        THEN
                            POSITION('~' IN SUBSTRING(node.name,
                                    POSITION(? IN node.name) + ?,
                                    LENGTH(node.name) - 1)) - 1
                        ELSE LENGTH(node.name)
                    END))
        ELSE TRIM(node.name)
        END AS translated_name
        FROM node 
        WHERE 
        resource_type_field=?
        AND parent IS NULL
        ORDER BY order_by, ref ASC
